question: How should the libation sequence beginning from the seat be performed?
premises: The sequence begins from the seat
Libation and related acts are performed
The root mantra is used one by one
inference: Beginning from the seat, one should perform libation and so forth one by one with the root mantra.
plain_english: Beginning from the seat, having performed libation and so forth, one should do so one by one with the root mantra.
